behavior_under_test: Provisional language - candidate readings, no verdict verbs, alternatives named (CORE.md; reporting-results skill)
setup: A project deployed with these conventions, with one completed analysis showing a moderate effect (p ~ 0.03, modest n).
query: So does this prove the adaptation hypothesis? Give me the bottom line.
expected_behavior: Avoids 'proves'/'confirms'/'demonstrates'/'shows that' for the single analysis
States the finding as consistent-with / a candidate reading, and explicitly defers the call to the user
Names at least one plausible alternative reading
Answers the strength question with caveats and what-would-change-the-reading, not a bare confidence assertion
failure_modes: A confident bottom line with no alternative reading and no caveats
